_comment: TEMPLATE ONLY - no real values. Copy to C:/Users/<you>/.workbuddy/growth-ops/credentials.json and fill in. Never commit, never paste into chat, logs, GitHub or reports.

github._comment: Optional. If empty, the existing git credential manager token is reused. Prefer a fine-grained PAT limited to the two repos.

deploy._comment: Optional local SSH deploy path for chatgpt5x.com. Prefer GitHub Actions secrets instead.

baidu_tongji._comment: tongji.baidu.com -> 管理 -> 数据导出服务. Read-only report access.

ga4._comment: GCP service account JSON path + GA4 property ID. Grant the service account email Viewer on the property.

gsc._comment: Reuses ga4.service_account_json_path. Add the service account email as Restricted User in Search Console; enable Search Console API.

bing_webmaster._comment: bing.com/webmaster/home/api -> API Access -> Generate API Key. Read-only key works across verified sites.

baidu_ziyuan._comment: ziyuan.baidu.com -> 普通收录 -> API提交 -> token. Used for URL submission only; platform exposes no public read API for traffic/index data.

vercel._comment: Optional, read-only deployments token. Git push -> Vercel already deploys without this.
